test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spick and span
solution:
The correct answer is **"To be neat and clean".** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Spick and span"** is an idiom used to describe something that is very clean and tidy.
 
• One may often hear this phrase used to describe a house or room that has been thoroughly cleaned and tidied. 
 
 
• **Example**- Their house is always spick and span.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **‘Option 3’**.
